What's ironic about the Michelob story is that in theory, at least, there were many premium brands on the market. Schlitz, Budweiser and Pabst, to name three. (In fact, all three brands still carry the word "premium" on the label.) But time had eroded their premium position. Michelob was launched with one of the great positioning lines of all time.
